purpose: Teach: 印紙/新法/極論/由緒/疑義/客員/総評/携え

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収書類の印紙を確認されますね
lines.en: The police do verify the official stamps on seized documents, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation with a slight upward lift at the end. Observational, not challenging. Warm acknowledgment of competence. Even pacing, no urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新法の運用を市民に周知されますね
lines.en: The police do make sure citizens understand how the new law will be applied, don't they?
lines.style: Same gentle affirmation. Nodding tone. Steady breath. Slightly longer pause before the tag question, as if reflecting on something reassuring.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、極論を取り締まる方針ではないですね
lines.en: The police don't take an extreme approach to cracking down, do they?
lines.style: Softer here — almost tentative, but still affirming. A small breath before 'don't they,' like he's checking something he hopes is true. Slower pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、由緒ある歴史的建物の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police do provide security for historically significant buildings too, don't they?
lines.style: Tone brightens slightly — pride in the scope of the work. Clear enunciation. Steady rhythm. The satisfaction of listing broader responsibilities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の疑義に丁寧に答えられますね
lines.en: The police do answer citizens' concerns carefully and respectfully, don't they?
lines.style: Warmth returns fully. Gentle emphasis on 'carefully.' Not performative — genuine observation. Even cadence. A slight trailing softness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、客員専門家も捜査に参加されますね
lines.en: The police do bring in guest specialists to help with investigations, don't they?
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Light interest — curious about collaboration. Mid-paced, engaged. The slight wonder of someone learning something good about an institution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、年次総評を市民に公表されますね
lines.en: The police do publish their annual review for the public to see, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Emphasis on transparency. Clear diction. The tone of someone who respects accountability. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の安全を携えて任務に臨まれますね
lines.en: The police do carry the responsibility for citizens' safety with them into every task, don't they?
lines.style: Shift to something deeper. More intimate tone. Slower pace. Weight of sincerity. The respect of someone who understands the burden. Slight pause before final phrase.
